example_dialogues.text_b: I am upset because I have to level the concrete floor again. I always check the screed board before levelling but this morning I forgot and it was such a silly mistake.
I am angry because I have to mix the mortar again. I always measure the sand correctly but this morning I forgot and the instructor marked me down.
I am tired because I have to carry all the cement bags again. I always stretch before lifting but today I forgot and my back already hurts.

dialogues.text_b: I am angry because I have to set the bricks again. I always check the guideline string carefully but today I forgot and the instructor marked me down.
I am tired because I have to smooth the plaster again. I always wet the trowel slightly but today I forgot and my feet already hurt after standing for so long.
I am upset because I have to cut all the tiles again. I always mark the lines correctly but today they were uneven and it was such a silly mistake.
I am angry because I have to check the scaffolding joints again. I always tighten the couplers properly but today I forgot and the instructor marked me down.
I am upset because I have to install the door frame again. I always align the hinges in advance but today I forgot and it was such a silly mistake.
I am tired because I have to shovel all the gravel again. I always get mixed duties during the day, but today I got only this and my feet already hurt.

activity_b.text: Good morning, Suresh. Nice to meet you.
Please relax and take a seat.
Good morning, sir. How are you today?
Quite good. I’m looking forward to talking to you about my career.
Let’s start with something simple then.
Tell me, what do you know about our company?
Last night I read about your company on the Internet.
I saw that you completed a housing project in Jaffna and that you focus strongly on safety and quality.
I also liked the way you use technology in your projects.
I’m glad you checked it.
Now, before we talk about your skills, tell me—what do you like most in the construction industry?
Honestly, sir, I like seeing real progress every day.
When we build a wall, fix formwork, or level a floor, I can see the result immediately.
I also enjoy working with a team.
That’s a good attitude.
And what tasks are you good at?
I am good at keeping the site organized and using different plastering techniques.
During my training, I built sample walls, levelled surfaces, and helped the instructor mark foundation lines.
And what technical skills do you have?
I know how to read simple site drawings, measure lengths, and use tools like trowels, plumb lines, and spirit levels.
Last month, I plastered a damaged section at the workshop.
We sometimes use laser levelling tools.
Are you familiar with them?
I am not familiar with them, sir, but I can read about them on the Internet.
That’s how I learned more about renovating old buildings.
Excellent.
Finally, why should we select you?
Because I learn fast, I work diligently, and I’m always ready to support the team.
Well said, Suresh. We’ll contact you soon.
